description: Replace an existing DNS record. This overwrites the whole record, so send every field it should keep: any omitted field is dropped, and leaving out ttl resets it to the default 3600 seconds. To change only some fields, use patch_dns_record instead. Returns the stored record.

alg.description: required for DS: the DNSSEC signing algorithm number, 0-255

data.description: the record's main value: an IPv4 address for A, an IPv6 address for AAAA, a hostname for ANAME/CNAME/MX/NS/SRV, free text for TXT, the CAA property value, or the hex hash for DS/TLSA

digest.description: required for DS: digest type of the hash in data (1 SHA-1, 2 SHA-256, 4 SHA-384)

domain_id.description: the Domeneshop domain ID, from list_domains

dtype.description: required for TLSA: matching type of the hash in data (0 exact match, 1 SHA-256, 2 SHA-512)

flags.description: required for CAA: 128 to mark the property critical, otherwise 0

host.description: the host/subdomain the record applies to, e.g. 'www' or '@' for the root

port.description: required for SRV: the port 0-65535 the service is found on

priority.description: required for MX and SRV: preference value 0-65535, lower is tried first

record_id.description: the DNS record ID to update, from list_dns_records

selector.description: required for TLSA: what the hash is taken from (0 full certificate, 1 subject public key)

tag.description: required for DS as a number (the key tag 0-65535 of the referenced DNSKEY) and for CAA as a string (the property tag, e.g. issue, issuewild or iodef)

ttl.description: time-to-live in seconds, 60-604800, must be a multiple of 60, defaults to 3600

usage.description: required for TLSA: certificate usage (0 PKIX-TA, 1 PKIX-EE, 2 DANE-TA, 3 DANE-EE)

weight.description: required for SRV: relative weight 0-65535 among records with the same priority

name: update_dns_record
title: Replace DNS record
